 Orange Beach Charter Fishing with Extreme Chaos Fishing Charters 
 
 
 
 Are you reelin for adventure on the Gulf Coast of Orange Beach, Alabama! Our charter fishing trips offer you the ultimate guide experience to hook your favorite saltwater fish in the Gulf Coast. 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 Book Now >
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 2026 SNAPPER SEASON starts IN may! Limited Availability - Call today to Book Your Charter! 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 Meet Captain Doug Maines 
 
 
 
 aka. "Captain Chaos" 
 
 
 
 I've been fishing Orange Beach, Gulf Shores, Pensacola, and other fishing spots near me my entire life. 
 
 
 
 As a young child my dad had me out pulling mullet nets and fishing piers on the bayou. After high school I enlisted in the Navy where I served on the U.S.S. Saratoga, which I really enjoyed. I served out my time with the Navy and went back to fishing, but this time it was charter fishing in Orange Beach, Alabama. I started out deck handing on the deck of many offshore boats and learned a lot about the different ways of deepsea fishing, then I got my first real gig with Captain Bligh. I have been in the charter fishing industry a long time and have met a lot of wonderful people. I love taking kids out fishing and watching their faces when they catch a nice fish. These are things that children don’t forget. I sure hope to meet y’all and make some great memories inshore, nearshore and offshore / deep sea fishing aboard Extreme Chaos Fishing Charters. Yours Truly, Captain Chaos 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 Meet Captain Doug Maines

 Experience the Thrill of Inshore Charter Fishing 
 
 
 
 Orange Beach Inshore Fishing Charters 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 Trips Start at $400
 
 
 
 
 2, 4, and 6 Hour Charters Available 
 
 
 
 
 Book Online or Call Today
 
 
 
 
 
 
 Escape to the tranquil waters of our favorite inshore fishing spots and embark on a fishing journey like no other. Inshore fishing is perfect for those looking to experience the calm and peaceful side of angling. Our expert guide will take you to the best spots where you can hook species like redfish, trout, and flounder. Enjoy the natural beauty of the coastline of Orange Beach as you cast your line and make memories that will last a lifetime!Book Your Inshore Fishing Trip Now! 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 Book Now
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 Find Adventure on the Gulf Coast with Nearshore Fishing 
 
 
 
 Orange Beach Nearshore Fishing Charters 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 Trips Start at $600
 
 
 
 
 4 and 6 Hour Charters Available 
 
 
 
 
 Book Online or Call Today
 
 
 
 
 
 
 Get ready to venture a bit farther from the shore and explore the abundant marine life in our nearshore fishing expeditions. With the horizon as your backdrop, you’ll have the chance to target a wide variety of fish, including snapper, king mackerel, and amberjack. Our experienced captain will guide you to the prime fishing waters where the action is hot, ensuring you an exhilarating day on the water. Book Your Nearshore Fishing Adventure Today! 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 Book Now
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 Explore The Gulf Shore with an Offshore Fishing Trip 
 
 
 
 Orange Beach Offshore Fishing Charters 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 Trips Start at $800
 
 
 
 
 4 and 6 Hour Charters Available 
 
 
 
 
 Book Online or Call Today
 
 
 
 
 
 
 For the ultimate angling experience, set your sights on offshore fishing! Our offshore adventures will take you to the deep blue waters where trophy fish like Red Snapper, Triggerfish, Vermillion Snapper, Amberjack and more await. Whether you’re a seasoned angler seeking a challenge or a novice looking for an extraordinary adventure, our boat and Captain Doug guarantee a thrilling and rewarding fishing expedition. Book Your Offshore Fishing Expedition Now! 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 Book Now
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 This is our first charter, what should we expect? 
 
 
 
 

 
 
 
 
 Embarking on your first charter fishing trip is an exciting adventure! Once you arrive, you’ll be greeted by the crew ready to assist you throughout the day. We’ll provide guidance on fishing techniques, safety protocols, and answer any questions you may have. Expect some amazing views, fishing action, moments of patience and excitement, options to catch and release or keep fish, and amazing memories. 
 
 
 
 
 
 Does Orange Beach have good fishing? 
 
 
 
 

 
 
 
 
 Absolutely! Orange Beach is renowned for having amazing fishing. 
 
 
 
 
 
 What kinds of fish can we we catch while fishing in Orange Beach waters? 
 
 
 
 

 
 
 
 
 Depending on the season, you can catch Red Snapper, Vermilion Snapper, Lane Snapper, Triggerfish, King mackerel (Kingfish), Spanish Mackerel, Redfish, Bluefish, Sheepshead, Catfish, and many other species. 
 
 
 
 
 
 What type of bait works best for fishing Orange Beach? 
 
 
 
 

 
 
 
 
 
 Live bait like shrimp and squid work well, but our crew will provide the bait based on the type of charter, season, and what we’re targeting. 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 What is provided? 
 
 
 
 

 
 
 
 
 
 The boat and captain, fishing gear, bait, safety equipment, cleaning of fish, expert guidance, scenic views, and fishing regulations information are all provided for you. 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 Will we catch fish? 
 
 
 
 

 
 
 
 
 
 The likelihood of catching fish during a charter fishing trip can vary depending on several factors, including location, season, weather, type of fishing, and patience. While there’s no guarantee of catching fish, Captain Doug works hard to provide the best experience possible. 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 Do we tip the crew? 
 
 
 
 

 
 
 
 
 
 Yes, it is customary to tip the captain/crew on a charter fishing trip. Tipping is a way to show appreciation for their hard work, expertise, and dedication to ensuring you have a successful and enjoyable fishing experience. As a general guideline, a common practice is approximately 15-20% of the total cost of the charter. However, you can adjust the tip based on your judgment of the service quality and your overall experience. 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 What should we bring? 
 
 
 
 

 
 
 
 
 
 We recommend bringing seasonal clothing, comfortable footwear, personal medications, motion sickness remedies, a cooler, fishing gear (optional), fishing hat, and most importantly, a positive attitude!Sunscreen is recommended – spray on sunscreen is however, not allowed. 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 Do we get to keep our fish? 
 
 
 
 

 
 
 
 
 
 Whether you get to keep the fish you catch depends on factors such as local regulations, the type of fish, and your personal preference. 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 What is your cancellation policy? 
 
 
 
 

 
 
 
 
 
 You can cancel or change your booking free of charge up to 3 days before the trip date. 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 What Are People Saying About Extreme Chaos Fishing Charters 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 We had a great time fishing with Captain Doug. He and his deckhand, Sam, made it so easy and enjoyable for the youngest to the oldest. This was our first time to fish with Extreme Chaos and it won't be our last. 
 
 
 Dana, M. 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 My husband and I had such a great time going out on the water and Captain Doug worked so hard to get us into a mess of fish. He was patient and always helpful. We listened to great music and there was plenty of space on the boat. When we got back he cleaned all the fish. Look forward to doing it again!

No need to pack a big cooler, you’ll be busy reelin! 
 
 
 Kris B. 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 This is the second time we have fished with Doug!! He takes care of his fishing clients and took right to where they were biting!! Highly recommend!! Great day had by all as the girls out fished the men!! 
 
 
 Kelly
